description: Filter modelled on a four-pole transistor ladder, with a lowpass and a highpass output

params.text: Sets the frequency where the filter begins to cut, from 8Hz to the top of the audible range
Emphasises the signal near the cutoff frequency; turned far up, the filter oscillates on its own
Scales the CUT input from -100% to 100%; at 100% that input moves the cutoff by an octave per volt
Adds gain into the filter model, saturating the signal for a dirtier sound
Scales the RES input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the DRIVE input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed

inputs.text: Moves the cutoff frequency by an amount set by the CUT knob
Moves the resonance by an amount set by the RES knob
Moves the drive by an amount set by the DRIVE knob

outputs.text: The lowpass output, passing frequencies below the cutoff and attenuating those above it
The highpass output, passing frequencies above the cutoff and attenuating those below it
